summary: Frontend only (Playwright, 390x844 + 375x667 + 768x1024 + 1280x900). The mobile hero on /accueil (landing-hero-mobile) shows Noisette (m-noisette.webp loaded, alt text present), the title, the blue band, both buttons, the 3 steps and the store badges. All 5 hero links go to the right page: estimate→/estimation-maison, signup→/sign-up, step-1/2/3→/estimation-maison, /etape-mise-en-vente, /etape-vendu. Everything below the hero is still there (mascot, free estimate form, demo, steps, data, reviews, CTA, footer). public-menu-button opens mobile-menu with all 5 links plus signin and signup; all 7 navigate and close the menu; mobile-menu-close and the backdrop close it. /welcome (mobile): welcome-hero, welcome-hero-signin→/sign-in, welcome-hero-menu opens mobile-menu, the page scrolls to the store badges at 375x667, nothing overlaps. Desktop: old hero (landing-hero-image), header nav Accueil · Estimation · Mise en vente · Documents · Conseils, no burger button, /welcome redirects to /accueil. Console: the 'two children with the same key' warning is gone; the only remaining warnings are 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (HeroMobile Svg) and the general 'shadow* deprecated'. Remaining issues: very small touch targets, poor contrast on the 'Créer mon compte' button, the typo 'Éstimer', and the step label truncated at 375px.

ui_bugs.issue: Typo: 'Éstimer gratuitement' should be 'Estimer gratuitement' (no accent). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/HeroMobile.tsx:94
At 375px width 'Mise en vente' is cut off as 'Mise en ven…' (numberOfLines=1, px(220) width, px(34) font). Fine at 390px. Reference: HeroMobile.tsx:106-113

issues: Touch targets too small: the estimate and signup buttons are about 137x23 px at 390 wide (height px(60)=23px, under 44). Text is about 11px (px(28)). welcome-hero-menu is 55x30 (hitSlop helps on native, but the visible area is still small). welcome-hero-signin is 41px high.
Contrast: the 'Créer mon compte' button has white text on rgb(127,163,227), about 2.4:1, which fails WCAG AA.
Lead text and step labels are about 13-14px. Since everything is scaled to width/1000, all text shrinks on small phones.
The current page is not highlighted in the menu (minor).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' comes from the pointerEvents='none' prop. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/HeroMobile.tsx:72

action_items: Give the hero buttons a minimum height of 44 (e.g. Math.max(44, px(60))) and a minimum font size of about 14. Do the same for the signin and menu targets in the header.
Improve contrast on the 'Créer mon compte' button: darker text (brandPrimary) or a darker background.
Avoid truncating 'Mise en vente' on narrow screens: allow 2 lines, or use a minimum font size or wider column.
Move pointerEvents='none' into style for the Svg in HeroMobile.tsx:72.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroMobile places everything with absolute positions scaled to width/1000. This matches the mockup, but text cannot reflow: with a large system font or a narrow screen, the text may overflow its fixed box (the lead is in a fixed area, the title has a fixed lineHeight).
MobileMenu testIDs contain spaces (mobile-menu-Mise en vente). They work, but a slug would be more robust.
In the 'Mon espace' signed-in branch of MobileMenu, the button has no testID (MobileMenu.tsx:43).

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all navigation and menu flows pass); design issues listed above

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile hero = HeroMobile (testID prefix landing-hero-mobile on /accueil, welcome-hero on /welcome). Mobile menu = public-menu-button / welcome-hero-menu → mobile-menu, items mobile-menu-{Label}. Breakpoints: isTablet >=768 (nav row, no burger), isDesktop web wide → old hero landing-hero-image.
